text:
morgan: Heads-up — noticed a module checksum mismatch in the gitops PR that would make the gpupool module get rolled back on the next reconcile. cc @kai @sasha :warning:

kai: where exactly? link to PR?

morgan: PR: https://git.company/repo/infra-gitops/pulls/482
It shows:
```
module.gpupool.module.kms_alias: "redwood-kms-v1" => "redwood-kms" (forces replace)
```
Reconcile logs: `gitops-controller` reported `checksum mismatch: module/gpupool@v2.2.0` and attempted a drift apply.

sasha: upstream gpupool module bumped to v2.2.0 this week and changed `kms_alias` type from `string` -> `object` (breaking input shape). We merged a dependent change into our monorepo but didn't pin the module in gitops. Staging already saw `terraform plan` showing replace.

devops-bot: gitops-reconcile - infra/gpupool - status: failed (1/3 attempts). See job: https://ci.company/jobs/1182 :robot_face:

lee: hold any automated reconcile to prod. I'll add a gate to the gitops pipeline to block changes that update module checksum without an approver.

morgan: agree. I'll open a hotfix PR to pin gpupool module to `v2.1.3` and add a checksum file check in the pipeline. Preparing PR now. Command I'm using:
```
# pin module in git
cd modules/gpupool
git checkout -b pin-gpupool-v2.1.3
# update module source to registry v2.1.3 and record checksum
```

kai: please also add a CI plan step that runs `terraform plan -target=module.gpupool` and fails on any `Force new resource` for `google_kms_crypto_key` / `kms_alias` changes. That will catch replacements early.

ops-qa: I'll run a manual plan in staging and snapshot the KV cache and node drain impact. If gpupool restarts we could have a 5–8 min window of degraded throughput; cost estimate ~= $120 extra if it retries heavy workloads.

sasha: long-term: we should require module changelogs + input contract tests for major bumps. Suggest adding a `schema_test` that validates input types for `kms_alias`.

devops-bot: CI status: branch pin-gpupool-v2.1.3 - lint: pass, plan-check: queued.

morgan: Action items: 1) I open PR to pin + add checksum blocker 2) @kai add targeted plan check in pipeline 3) @sasha add schema_test in module repo 4) @lee enable temporary reconcile hold until PR merges.

lee: noted, will flip the hold toggle and post when done. :white_check_mark:

morgan: thanks — will update thread with PR link and staging plan output.
